verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI is an open-source Python library that runs as a plain object anywhere — web frontend, terminal, background queue, or voice call — with no required vendor service; model access and observability (Logfire) are explicitly optional add-ons, and community reports confirm production deployments entirely under the user's own infrastructure. Missing for 10: explicit statement on self-hosting/on-prem licensing details or infra requirements, and no first-party deployment guide addressing air-gapped/enterprise infra specifically.
